summary: The ProgramYearType class defines a structure for managing and returning a list of program year data, which includes codes and their corresponding values. This is used primarily in the context of managing program years within a system, offering methods to generate lists of program years based on configurations and input parameters.
purpose: To provide a structured way to manage and retrieve program year data for different programs, enabling the system to handle various configurations and offer consistent outputs based on program requirements.

fields.name: Code
fields.description: Represents the code for a program year.

fields.name: Value
fields.description: Represents the value associated with the program year code.

workflows.name: ProgramYearList Generation
steps: Retrieve maximum program year configuration using Codes.CodeLookup with the 'Configuration' and 'MaxProgramYear' parameters.
Attempt to parse the retrieved configuration value into an integer, maxProgramYear.
If successful, initialize a ProgramYearData list starting with a default entry ('-1', '').
Iterate from 1 up to maxProgramYear, appending each to the list as ProgramYearData.
Finalize the list with a special entry ('0', Resources.NotApplicable).
Handle the case where session or configuration is invalid by returning a default list with five years.

validations: Ensure maxProgramYear configuration value is parsable to an integer.
system_behavior: Returns a default list when session or configuration values are invalid.
Generates program year data lists dynamically based on configuration or program details.
